use default

decorate_sort_undecorate[T, K: Ghul.Comparable[K]]
    (items: Iterable[T], key: (T) -> K) -> Pipe[T]
is
    let decorated =
        items |> map(item => (item, key = key(item))) |> collect_list()

    let sorted = decorated |> sort_by(pair => pair.key) |> collect_list()

    sorted |> map(pair => pair.item)

use default

decorate_sort_undecorate[T, K: Ghul.Comparable[K]]
    (items: Iterable[T], key: (T) -> K) -> Pipe[T]
is
    let decorated =
        items |> map(item => (item, key = key(item))) |> collect_list()

si

let words =

write_line(words |> decorate_sort_undecorate(w => w.length) |> join(", "))
